basis: The user authorized architecture iteration and bounded training. Compare two branches of the same project-trained checkpoint on the same P202 curriculum for at most 100 updates each: frozen original language blocks versus trainable copies initialized from those same blocks. Both branches reset AdamW and sampler identically; no external model weights are used.
limitations: The source is noisy translated synthetic children's fiction; the 64-example source review was model-authored, with six major defects.
This comparison is not equal compute, not a multi-seed experiment, and does not validate general chat or memory alignment.
No final evaluation texts may be read. The original individual and all historic checkpoints remain unchanged.
